guideUpdate.title: Zoom the GIS map without losing a loaded Surveyor layer or its display setting
guideUpdate.affectedSection: GIS map navigation and layer display settings
steps: Open GIS and load a Surveyor layer.
Select Zoom in to view a closer map scale while keeping the Surveyor layer loaded.
Select Zoom out to return to the previous map scale without adding the layer again.
Open Display Settings for the Surveyor layer to view its Show linked sites setting.
screenshotCaptions: Surveyor - Service is loaded at the settled 100 km map scale before zooming in.
After one zoom-in, the map is at the closer 50 km scale and Surveyor - Service remains visible in Map layers and the legend.
After zooming back out, the map returns to the 100 km scale and the same Surveyor - Service layer remains loaded.
After the zoom journey, Display Settings for Surveyor - Service shows Show linked sites checked.
